official: 品川区国民健康保険条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案

name: 国保料に子ども・子育て支援分を追加
summary: 現在の国民健康保険料は、基礎賦課額、後期高齢者支援金等賦課額、介護納付金賦課額で算定しています。この議案で、令和8年度分から子ども・子育て支援納付金分を設け、各区分の保険料率などと低所得世帯の軽減基準を改めます。
changes: 子ども・子育て支援納付金分に所得割0.27%、均等割1,800円、18歳以上の均等割73円を設ける
基礎賦課額の所得割を7.71%から7.51%、均等割を47,300円から47,600円、限度額を66万円から67万円に改める
後期高齢者支援金等分の所得割を2.69%から2.80%、均等割を16,800円から17,600円に、介護納付金分の所得割を2.25%から2.43%、均等割を16,600円から17,800円に改める
低所得世帯の保険料軽減に使う所得基準額を引き上げる
who: 品川区の国民健康保険加入者
保険料軽減の対象となる低所得世帯
why: 子ども・子育て支援金制度の創設に伴い、支援納付金分の保険料率などを定め、基礎賦課額の保険料率などを改める必要があるためと、区長は説明しています。

en.name: Adds a child and childcare support contribution to National Health Insurance premiums
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Shinagawa City National Health Insurance Ordinance
en.summary: National Health Insurance premiums are currently calculated from the basic assessment amount, the assessment amount for support contributions for older people, and the assessment amount for long-term care contributions. This bill adds a child and childcare support contribution portion starting with premiums for fiscal year 2026, and revises the premium rates and other amounts for each portion, as well as the income thresholds for reductions for low-income households.
changes: Sets an income-based rate of 0.27%, a per-person amount of ¥1,800, and a per-person amount of ¥73 for people aged 18 and over for the child and childcare support contribution portion
Changes the income-based rate for the basic assessment amount from 7.71% to 7.51%, the per-person amount from ¥47,300 to ¥47,600, and the limit from ¥660,000 to ¥670,000

Changes the income-based rate for support contributions for older people from 2.69% to 2.80% and the per-person amount from ¥16,800 to ¥17,600; changes the income-based rate for long-term care contributions from 2.25% to 2.43% and the per-person amount from ¥16,600 to ¥17,800
Raises the income thresholds used to reduce premiums for low-income households
who: Shinagawa City residents enrolled in National Health Insurance
Low-income households eligible for premium reductions
en.why: The mayor says this is necessary to set the premium rates and other amounts for the contribution portion following the creation of the child and childcare support contribution system, and to revise the premium rates and other amounts for the basic assessment portion.
